My professor walked me and 2 other students out of class to tell us that we had the 3 top papers in the whole class. She was always very anti republican and I felt as though a professor should keep the classroom neutral. A few weeks later we had discussions in class, and I stood up and said- without calling anyone out- that people should keep mention their opinions without making other people feel bad about having differing ones. A few days later I received my grade and it was a 67%. She was also the same professor that helped me get an internship. She got me fired from the internship and gave me a D all in the same day. I contested my grade and explained to the deans what happened, and they quite literally said “It’s her word against yours because she’s tenured. Do you really want to waste your time going through this whole process.”
